description.zh:
接入来源。取值：

- **share**：表示公共云CNAME接入。

- **asset**：表示自定义资产接入。

- **hybrid_cloud_cname**：表示混合云CNAME接入。

- **tgw**：表示云产品接入。
description.en:
The source of the domain name. Valid values:

- **share**: The domain name is added to WAF in CNAME record mode.

- **asset**: The domain name is added to WAF as a custom asset.

- **hybrid\_cloud\_cname**: The domain name is added to WAF in hybrid cloud CNAME record mode.

- **tgw**: The domain name is added to WAF in cloud native mode.
The domain name that you want to query for ownership verification content.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-verify-content --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-000 --domain-name example.com --access-origin share --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
